Sculpting Framework

Turn rough problems into aligned, scoped, implementation-ready vertical slices.
An end-to-end, tool-agnostic AI agent plugin & skill set for Product Engineers.

v1.0.1  ·  MIT License  ·  SKILL.md & MCP

--- ## Why Sculpting? AI coding assistants and spec-driven dev tools already handle writing code, TDD, and code reviews. For modern **Product Engineers**, the real bottleneck is everything **before** the first commit: - Framing the right problem before jumping to solutions - Asking the right stakeholder the right 3 questions at the right time - Cutting scope ruthlessly (**Hard No-Go** vs. **Deferred**) without losing alignment - Closing technical/compliance unknowns *before* sprint planning - Handling real-world chaos: delayed decisions, mid-flight pivots, 1-week P0 pauses, and owner handoffs Like sculpting a block of stone, software delivery is not waterfall — it is **progressive resolution**. **Sculpting** guides you and your AI agent from raw block to polished release in four crisp stages, without AI slop or enterprise ceremony. ```text [ Raw Idea / Problem ] │ ▼ 1. BLOCK — Problem without solution words, cost of inaction, │ Template 1 Async Discovery Pings, Living State Card ▼ 2. ROUGH CUT — Realistic options (Anti-Strawman), No-Go vs. Deferred, │ Pre-Detail Spike (Template 5), Vendor/DPA Gate, │ Business Rules (Template 3) & Sign-off Lock (Template 2) ▼ 3. DETAIL — Codebase-grounded contracts, Vertical Slices (Template 4), │ Conflict-free parallelism & 1-line capacity confirmations ▼ 4. POLISH — Handoff to coding/TDD/review skills, No-Go scope brake, progressive rollout, release comms & impact closure ``` --- ## Key Features - **Zero Bureaucracy on Small Tasks (`Fast-Track`):** ≤2-day, single-service micro-features skip heavy templates and move in **1 async turn** (3 questions + 1-line No-Go → single ticket → build). - **Anti-Slop & Anti-Over-Engineering:** Zero framework jargon in outgoing team messages. No strawman options just to fill tables. - **Minimal Recovery Protocol (1 Card + 2 Rules):** - **Living State Card:** A single 10–15 line SSoT pinned at the top of your doc for instant post-pause catch-up and cold owner handoffs. - **Assumption + Expiry:** Unblock delayed stakeholders on *no-regret* work while locking irreversible investments. - **Delta & Sign-off Reset:** Handle pivots, 5+ day pauses, or owner handoffs with a concise delta — never rewrite the RFC. - **Tool-Agnostic Core:** Works with MCP-connected tools (Notion, Linear, Jira, Slack, GitHub), webhooks/CLI, or plain manual handoffs via a one-time **Context Layer**. - **Empirically Stress-Tested:** Validated across **7 multi-agent simulations** covering cross-team billing, SSO/RBAC compliance, GDPR data residency, chaos disruptions, veto deadlocks, 1-day micro-features, and an A/B regression test ([see validation log](docs/simulations.md)). --- ## Included Skills | Skill | Stage | Responsibility | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | **`sculpting`** | Orchestrator | First-time Context Layer onboarding, Triage, Fast-Track, Minimal Recovery Protocol, and stage routing | | **`sculpting-block`** | Stage 1 — Block | Solution-free problem framing, Living State Card initialization, and Template 1 Async Discovery Pings | | **`sculpting-rough-cut`** | Stage 2 — Rough Cut | Realistic options, Hard No-Go vs. Deferred, Vendor/DPA gate, Pre-Detail Spike (Template 5), Templates 2 & 3, and 25-min Meeting Fallback | | **`sculpting-detail`** | Stage 3 — Detail | Codebase-grounded contracts, Template 4 Vertical Slices, single-owner parallelism check, and 1-line capacity confirmations | | **`sculpting-polish`** | Stage 4 — Polish | Handoff to coding/review skills, No-Go scope brake, rollout/telemetry verification, release comms, and impact closure | --- ## Installation Sculpting follows the open **`SKILL.md`** and marketplace plugin standards, so it works out of the box across major AI coding environments. ### Antigravity Clone or copy this repository into your Antigravity plugins directory: ```bash git clone https://github.com/mskasal/sculpting-framework.git ~/.gemini/config/plugins/sculpting-framework ``` *(Antigravity reads the root `plugin.json`, `assets/icon.png`, and `skills/*/SKILL.md` automatically.)* ### Claude Code Install directly as a Claude Code plugin marketplace repository: ```bash /plugin marketplace add mskasal/sculpting-framework /plugin install sculpting-framework@sculpting-framework-marketplace ``` ### Cursor / Codex / Other `SKILL.md` Agents Install via `skills` CLI or copy the `skills/` directory into `.cursor/skills/` or `.claude/skills/`: ```bash npx skills add mskasal/sculpting-framework ``` --- ## Quick Start 1. **Start a new feature:** > *"Let's sculpt a new feature: enterprise customers need Net-30 invoicing with EU VAT reverse-charge."* 2. On your first run, **`sculpting`** asks 4 quick questions to create your workspace **Context Layer** (`sculpting.context.md`) — team owners, veto holders, escalation owner, tool adapters, and red lines. 3. The agent automatically triages the work into **Fast-Track** or **Block → Rough Cut → Detail → Polish** and guides you through each gate. --- ## Documentation - [Sculpting Framework v1.0 Specification](docs/framework-v1.0.md) - [Empirical Validation Log (7 Simulations)](docs/simulations.md) ## License [MIT](LICENSE) — created by [Samed Kasal](https://github.com/mskasal).
